hollow_delve_depth.generation_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: independently scrolling depth layer for a claustrophobic side-scrolling game interior
Primary request: Low limestone mine tunnel
Materials: Damp blue-gray limestone with readable layered chips and restrained mineral seams; occasional worn timber embedded in the wall. Compact abandoned horizontal mine tunnel. Ceiling: thick rough limestone slabs with short blunt stalactites, a few thin mineral seams and worn timber braces pressed into the rock.
Composition: Opaque distant recess layer only. A close horizontal band of dark shallow recesses in an enclosed passage, interrupted by dim silhouettes of distant supports. Subtle atmospheric depth and a narrow value range. No enormous chamber, vertical abyss, soaring pillars or receding corridor. No foreground ceiling, floor, nearby wall piers, props or characters. Fill the entire image; any visible recess has an enclosed back.
Camera: strict orthographic side view along a horizontal tunnel, parallel to the image plane. The passage continues sideways off both edges.
Style/medium: Refined dark fantasy pixel art at the same texture density as the Wetlands environment. Fine deliberate pixel clusters and readable material edges, with medium surface detail and restrained contrast. Retain the full generated texture resolution; do not simulate a tiny pixel grid or enlarge chunky blocks. Group value and hue behind actors, keeping bright accents sparse. Crisp texture, no photographic noise or blur.
Color palette: Cold slate #394757, charcoal #171e25, subdued gray limestone #727c82, desaturated old timber #635044 and small dull rust accents.
Lighting: Soft cold reflected light from the passage, shallow ambient shadow beneath the roof; no bright opening or dramatic spotlight.
Canvas: 640 by 360 logical units; generate a large image with width at least 1536 pixels and this aspect ratio.
Opacity: completely opaque edge-to-edge image.
If a reference image is supplied, use it for pixel texture density and restrained shading only; keep the requested indoor subject and enclosed composition.
Avoid: tiny-resolution upscaling, flat featureless polygons, photorealism, harsh white highlights, vast cave expanses, soaring ceilings, long vanishing-point corridors, characters, text, UI and watermarks.

edits.prompt:
Use case: background-extraction
Asset type: transparent wall layer PNG for a game.
Input image 1 is the edit target. Preserve the stone piers, timber braces, low wall, layout, texture, colors, dimensions and all subject pixels. Remove the entire white-and-gray checkerboard background, including the empty gaps between the piers and the narrow strip below the wall. These areas MUST be genuine fully transparent alpha in the delivered PNG, not painted white, black or a visible checkerboard pattern. There must be no background image at all behind the isolated stonework. Do not add a floor, shadows, new objects or any text. Output RGBA PNG with actual transparency.
